pre_dispatch_gate: The driver invokes the frozen read-only verifier admit command itself before render or app-server creation; failed admission is a positive no-start controller-invalid receipt.

identity.provider_effective_limitation: Requested route, openai provider, turn-context model/effort, and pm-dev thread/turn are attestable; a separate provider-effective serving snapshot is not exposed.

completed_subject_evidence.rule: After turn/start is sent and the unique task completes, response-shape, JSON, schema, canonicalization, duplicate-key, multi-content, missing-final, and prohibited-activity nonconformance remains completed permanent first-attempt subject evidence.
captured_fields: single text output or null with exact UTF-8 SHA-256 and bytes
full prohibited activity item array and exact binding

controller_invalid.positive_no_start_rule: External verifier may admit exact recreation only when every preserved controller-invalid receipt says subject_call_started=false and the frozen input/route remain identical.
controller_invalid.sent_turn_start_rule: The driver marks subject_call_started=true before sending turn/start; started or uncertain calls are never recreated by this driver.

nonclaims: Completed transport is not semantic PASS.
Static verification is not empirical qualification or production enforcement.
